notes.title: #4 Compass & Fixes Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35034276/be26078a8cfb8ff57c4f62f829d11255d8ebb4ce.gif[/img]

Hi, Misty World explorers, recently we've rolled out a next small update which includes some important features.

[h3]Compass[/h3]
Now you have a small arror located inside your life bar that shows where the Map in the Camp is. It always shows you the Camp direction.

With this addon and a map in your Pause Menu you can effectively navigate through the Misty World to reach your goals.

[h3]Other improvements:[/h3]
UPD: Terrain and navmesh to eliminame places you can get stuck. 
UPD: Removed non-walkable areas where you could get with a Teleport.
UPD: New sounds for swamp areas:  walking sounds and swamp ambient.

We still work on Butler's Diary update that will bring new challenges and story lines to Primal Ritual as well as testing new guns mechanics.

Thanks for suppoting us!

GexagonVR Team

notes.title: #3 Bugs & Fixes Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35034276/4ed9d458f14e825797d032dc58c41438e1615d70.png[/img]
Hi Misty World Explorers!

During the last week, you may noticed some small updates were coming out for Primal Ritual. Here is a list of the latest tweaks and bugfixes. 

[b]We hope after these days we cleared all the main bugs and prepaired for you something more... Big updates soon![/b]

UPD: New Tips for New Game, Saving and loading functions.
UPD: Reworked Conway's landing Teleport Repair scene. Now it has move silence and delivers the task more casualy.
UPD: Sound manager updated so now it can control more sounds.
UPD: Blocked Pause menu in the dialogues, you have to wait till it ends.

NEW: Added new swamp ambient sounds
NEW: Electricity sounds on Conway's landing

FIX: Blue spiders do not stuck on your head anymore. So you do not recieve random damage anymore.
FIX: Annoying bug when Trigger and Grip buttons could swap their functions.
FIX: Nevmesh bugs and places you can stuck.
FIX: Trees' lods
FIX: Electricity sparks sometimes did not work
FIX: New colliders added were needd.
FIX: Bug when you could press engine buttons several times and mess with mission.

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1070410/discussions/0/1738882605422789696/]You can discuss this update on Steam forums here.[/url]

notes.title: Spider Song Page Launch
notes.content:
store.steampowered.com/app/1087970/Nevrosa_Spider_Song/
Hello friends, today we launched Nevrosa: Spider Song Steam page. 

[h1]The biggest news are that the game won't be free.[/h1]
Yes, this decision was really unexpected even for us, but the things this year are not so good for our small team so we had to make this hard decision. 

We'd better go this way than risk Primal Ritual launch and ruin your expectations.

[b]The price will be $1.99 — this is the minimum price we can set that could boost the further development.[/b]

We will add two DLCs for those who want to help us more and get some nice bonuses.

Spider Song will be included into further game packs with Primal Ritual and Nevrosa so this small purchase will help you to get a bigger discount for other our games.

[h1]Differences from the previous free version we launched on Primal Ritual page[/h1]
[list]
[*]Brought back all interactions with the objects — switches, buttons, turning levers.
[*]You can keep playing after the chapter ends — you will not be able to progress (only in the upcoming big game) but you can explore the Forest.
[*]Updated control scheme, added controller-directed free locomotion. UI and Tips updated.
[*]Papers from The Majordomo’s Diary to learn more about the world and story.
[*]Achievements! Explore the area and collect them all.
[*]Support DLCs with sweet bonuses to help us stay afloat while preparing Primal Ritual launch. 
[*]Movement optimization, lots of bug fixes and narrative improvements. [/list]

Thank you for staying with us, please, add new page to your wishlist, we will launch the game as soon as we can.

Your support is very important for us.

GexagonVR Team.

notes.title: Making a Short Game from the Demo
notes.content:
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1070410/announcements/detail/1603756162552513205][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35034276/d464b05e70dffafb2a137842df0000398ea2fa4d.jpg[/img][/url]
[h1]Hello everyone![/h1]
Thank you for your interest in Nevrosa Universe, we are glad that you like our ideas.

We decided to remove the current Demo files from Steam Store and launch a separate short experience for free with a separate Steam page.

No worries if it disappears from your library — that's for a greater good.

This Demo story is different from the Primal Ritual plot and suggest a slightly another view so we want you to be able to replay it and it does not matter you own the upcoming big game or not.

[h1]So what to expect in re-launch?[/h1]
[list]
    [*]Lots of bugfixes.
    [*]Return of all interactions with the game objects (in the demo it was quite limited).
[*] Better narrative in some situations.
[*]Possibly Support and Wallpaper Pack DLCs to attach the free game to your Game Library and support the development. 
[/list]

[h1]When is re-launch?[/h1]
We plan to create a new page and upload updated verion during this week, please, stay tuned. There may be some changes if we decide to add some more features from the full game. 
Add Primal Ritual to your Wishlist and Follow!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35034276/208d04ca37e1a89ae0f5446221d35143377da41a.gif[/img]

GexagonVR Team.
